frames.why: Worried woman facing another person with bag at her feet fits the reluctant, tense exchange, but the picture does not show the yes/no friction mechanism.
Anxious woman clutching the bag with the other person gone fits grabbing the bag and fleeing; escape is only implied by absence, not shown as cause to effect.
Uneasy, pained expression conveys mood, but the viewer read it as taking on a burden, not an ominous cloud over the weekend; no stalling-to-dread link is shown.
